Set `identity` to an object containing the actual numeric `version` and string `sha256` from that same result; never put version/sha256 at the request root. Set `edits` to an array of intent objects, not a command string or JSON Schema. Do not send `additionalProperties`, `command`, root `name` or root `widget`. Supported intents: annotateExisting, insertLiteralParameter, changeWidget, moveGroup, hideParameter. Review the returned preview and validation. Plan is an in-memory transaction, not a filesystem artifact: never create plan.md or directories for it. An edit name is a declared parameter such as width, not a group label such as Dimensions. Plan changes nothing; it expires in 120 seconds. Commit using exactly `mode: "commit"` and `planId` copied from successful plan `data.planId`. They preserve the existing default: never send `defaultValue` for them. Include group/description on that same widget edit rather than creating a second incomplete widget edit. `insertLiteralParameter` additionally requires a typed `defaultValue`. `moveGroup` accepts only `kind,name,group`; `hideParameter` accepts only `kind,name`. Never restore an old full file over newer edits.

Diagnostic policy: ordinary SCAD requires no Customizer grammar. Candidate metadata does not represent an error. Do not invent missing-annotation, unsupported-default, duplicate-assignment or style warnings; normal usage must remain silent.
